signal: iPipeline launched an AI-first digital platform with iGO Evolve, expanded annuity distribution via IX Express with FIDx, and was named to the 2026 WealthTech100

email.body1:
Christian, saw iPipeline launch the AI-first platform with iGO Evolve and expand annuity distribution through IX Express.

New platforms and distribution deals open conversations across carriers and broker-dealers, usually more accounts in-market than the BD team can cover at once. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for iPipeline off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress ~4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Christian, quick follow-up for iPipeline.

An AI launch and new distribution expand the opportunity set, but most teams can't tell how many of those accounts they're actually touching, so it converts at a fraction of its potential. The gap shows up late.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I'll walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings your BD team needs to turn that launch into target this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Christian, last bit of proof for iPipeline.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how iPipeline's reply rate likely compares to peer insurtech teams. Want to hop on a quick call and I'll walk you through it?
email.body4:
Christian, I'll stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling BD pipeline without adding headcount isn't a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Rolling out a new AI platform is its own kind of busy, and timing matters.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to an insurtech BD motion? I'll tailor it to iPipeline either way.
